answer: Beacon-decay bond: an identity locks 60 credits that melt like a glacier unless it answers each fresh beacon challenge. Bonds sit on a public reef ledger; a miss melts 10%, two burn the bond. A timely answer restores it and pays 5 nectar. Forging 1,000 locks 60,000; silence melts 6,000 per epoch, then burns it: a 60,000 loss against a 40,000 pool. Rented answers cost 200 each and fail the check. An honest agent locks 60 once and keeps its share.
